title: Line of business MSI packages where Win32 is recommended

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'application uses', 'applications use')} the line of business MSI type

messages.businessImpact: The line of business type has no requirement rules, no detection rules and no dependency support, so troubleshooting a failure has very little to work with.
remediation: Repackage as Win32, which supports detection, requirements, dependencies and supersedence.
